votes.section: APPOINT THE NEW COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT DIRECTOR
votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to appoint Jim Bolser as the new Community Development Director.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Tanner ordinance amending Ordinance No. 2023-03-003 adopting a temporary regulation suspending the permitting or processing of special event permits under Title 3, Chapter 10 of the City code.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve the consent calendar as presented.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.section: PUBLIC HEARING/AMEND THE FISCAL YEAR 2022-23 BUDGET/RESOLUTION
votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve the resolution to review and approve amendments to the Fiscal Year 2022-23 Budget.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve the hillside development permit to allow disturbance of areas in the 20-30%, 30-40% slope areas on approximately 14.99 acres generally located at the end of the existing Flowers Way in Desert Canyons on the north side of Southern Hills Parkway.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Tanner to approve the preliminary plat for the Leslie Dunbar Trust, a 2-lot residential subdivision containing 6.94 acres located east of the George Washington Academy property on the southwest corner of future 2220 South and 3210 East.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve the preliminary plat for Old Farm, a 4-lot subdivision containing 76.04 acres located on the northwest corner of 2450 South and 3000 East.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve the preliminary plat for Smith's Marketplace Sun River, a 4-lot subdivision containing 15.96 acres located at approximately 4582 South Pioneer Road.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Tanner to approve the preliminary plat for White Trails Phases 4-6, an 85-unit residential subdivision containing 12.87 acres located north of White Dome Drive and east of River Road.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to appoint the Commission Members as stated.
votes.result: 4-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to adjourn.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
